title: The UI must compare identifiers by the same rule as the core
rule: When the UI maps a name back to an id (tags, collections, presets), use an exact match first and then the core's own equality rule, not a stricter or looser one. fm-core's `COLLATE NOCASE` and `eq_ignore_ascii_case` fold A–Z only, so `toLowerCase()` (Unicode) can merge two names the core keeps apart and resolve the wrong id. Share one helper for the rule (for tags: `sameTagName` in `stores/tags.ts`) and test it with names that differ only in non-ASCII case ("Äb"/"äb").
rationale: E7.2 (#83): `useTagsStore.idOf` used Unicode `toLowerCase()` while fm-core folds ASCII only, so 'Remove tag äb' could untag 'Äb' and report success.
